x: Picking out individuals it is worth noting that Jessica Palmer has continued the improvement she showed from last season and was joined in the Sprints by Yvette Edward Cindy James, Angela Abrams and Andrea Abrams, Nina Christou and Tracy Ritson.

The other records came from Cindy James in the Discus (also breaking the Intermediate record) Tracy Ritson in the Girls Javelin (this erases a record that had stood for 7 years) and a fine win in the 4 x 400m Relay to knock 3 seconds off the old record.
